subject: Assurance Integrator: SLA & evidence handoff for upcoming SOC2 + PT window
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: AssureTech Integrations <integrations@assuretech.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Assurance Integrator: SLA & evidence handoff for upcoming SOC2 + PT window

Hi Katie / AssureTech team,

Thanks for agreeing to partner on the October SOC2 refresh and the coordinated pentest window the week of 10/18. Two asks to scope next steps so we can finalize the intake:

1) SLA & retention: we need your proposed SLA for evidence pickup and availability (target: <24h retrieval for artifact requests during the test window) and confirmation that artifacts will be escrowed for 30 days post-test.
2) Evidence list: please confirm the minimal artifact list you require (control owners, config exports, logs, scoped samples). I attached our partner_intake_form and an initial artifact spreadsheet.
3) Oncall & escalation: provide a primary and secondary oncall with phone and PGP if possible. During the test week we’ll route evidence requests via the integrator to avoid direct pentest queries to product teams.

We’re on a tight timeline — legal/procurement need the DocuSign before 10/14 to meet the auditor window. Can you confirm by EOD today?

Thanks,

—
Ben Carter
Senior Partner Manager, Alliances
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: partner_intake_form.pdf, evidence-artifact-list.xlsx
From: Katie Lin <katie@assuretech.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Assurance Integrator: SLA & evidence handoff for upcoming SOC2 + PT window

Ben —

Appreciate the note. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying questions below:

SLA & retention:
- We can commit to a 24-hour artifact retrieval SLA during the active test window for items flagged as high priority. For internal audits we offer a 72-hour SLA for historical pulls.
- Escrow: we support holding artifacts for 30 days in our secure evidence vault; beyond that we can archive with a signed retention schedule.

Evidence list:
- We reviewed your spreadsheet. To avoid scope creep please confirm whether you can provide scoped log exports (48-hour slices) vs full retention pulls. Our recommended minimal set: network config snapshots, test account access logs, service principal keys rotated snapshots, and a sample of automated backup manifests.

Oncall & escalation:
- Primary: Katie Lin (katie@assuretech.io, +1 650-555-2107)
- Secondary: Marco Ruiz (marco@pentestco.com, +1 206-555-9987) — Marco’s team will handle pentest coordination and evidence packaging.

DocuSign & procurement:
- I’ll send a DocuSign link for the SLA & AM agreement now. One ask from our side: can you confirm the billing contact and PO route so we mark the engagement as non-recurring?

We’ll follow up with a short statement-of-work (SOW) that enumerates the deliverables and delivery windows.

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Assurance Integrator: SLA & evidence handoff for upcoming SOC2 + PT window

Ben / Katie —

Quick internal note for the thread: legal reviewed the SLA draft and wants the following baked in before signature:

- A 30-day escrow retention clause (no deletion without mutual written consent).
- Defined chain-of-custody for artifacts (hashing + timestamping).
- A limitation on re-use: integrator may not use artifacts for benchmarking or third-party disclosure without prior approval.

Operational ask: if AssureTech can provide a sample hashed artifact package (screenshot + sha256 of one config export) we can show auditors during pre-review and shorten the review loop.

Ben — I’ll loop in procurement privately on the PO route but confirm: invoice to Redwood Inference, Attn: Procurement, PO required.

—
Marissa Cole
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com

Katie —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirm PO route: Procurement (procurement@redwood-inference.com) will issue a one-time PO; billing contact is accounts-payable@redwood-inference.com. We’ll treat the engagement as one-off for audit purposes.

On the scoped logs question: security prefers scoped 48-hour slices for any on-demand pulls to reduce blast radius and reduce engineering lift — we can provide a runbook for the extraction. If Marco needs full retention we need justification; please flag any full-pull requests to my team first.

Marissa — can you confirm the legal phrasing for the chain-of-custody and the no-reuse clause? If you’re good we’ll sign the SLA after we get the sample hashed package.

Ben
